abstract.text: This article describes the KeyboardKit autocomplete engine.

inlineContent.text: Autocomplete is an important part of the typing experience, where suggestions can be presented in a toolbar as the user types, and an incorrectly typed text can be autocorrected.
In KeyboardKit, an
can provide autocomplete suggestions and predictions. Unlike other services, you must use KeyboardKit Pro to unlock an autocomplete service, or implement it yourself.
